shared_elements: schematic linear figures with repeated projecting strokes (rays in A, comb-teeth in B)
rectangular framed/latticed forms (offering table and text panels in A, ladder-like bodies in B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry linear forms with repeated short strokes and rectangular grid-like shapes, which any tradition could produce independently. A depicts a fully articulated narrative scene with human figures, a rayed disc, an offering table and dense sign-bands, while B shows only two or three highly schematic comb-bodied creatures floating with no scene, no human figures and no framing registers.
